tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /zab lam rdo rje rnal 'byor gyi bla brgyud gsol 'debs bzhugs so/ /

na maḥshrī rat+na gu ru bh+yaḥ zab lam rdo rje'i rnal 'byor gyi dpal ldan bla ma rin po che rnams la gsol ba 'debs pa/ dpal ldan bla ma'i byin brlabs dang dngos grub kyi yon tan thams cad 'byung bar byed pa zhes bya ba/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo chos rje bla ma rin po che'i zhabs kyi pad+mo dri ma med pa la gus pas phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su 'chi'o/ /sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las thams cad kyi bdag dang mtha' yas pa'i sems can thams cad la dus dang rnam pa thams cad du byin gyis brlabs tu gsol lo/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas kun gyi sku gsung thugs/ ye shes rdo rje'i ngo bo sku bzhi'i bdag/ mkhyen pa bzhi ldan byang chub bzhi brnyes pa'i/ /dpal ldan bla ma mchog la gsol ba 'debs/ /rnam kun mchog ldan sna tshogs gzugs 'chang zhing*/ mtha' yas 'gro ba'i skad kyis chos kun ston/ /mtha' gnyis rnam spangs zung 'jug bde ba che/ dpal ldan rdo rje 'chang la= rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i gsung rab rgya mtsho'i tshogs/ sgrib bral rna ba'i dbang pos legs 'dzin nas/ /'gro ba kun skad so sor bsdud mdzad pa'i/ /gsang bdag zla ba bzang = mtshan dang dpe byad bzang pos rab mdzes shing*/ /dbang phyug yon tan thams cad rab rdzogs la| |phun tshogs sa bcu'i rtogs pa rab rgyas pa'i/ /shākya'i rgyal po drug= dus gsum rgyal ba kun kyi ye shes sku/ /rigs bzhi rdo rje'i rigs su legs bsdus nas| |dpal ldan bsdus pa'i rgyud rgyal ston mdzad pa'i/ /'jam dbyangs grags pa'i zhabs= sangs rgyas kun gyi thugs rje gcig bsdus pa/ rje btsun spyan ras gzigs kyi sprul pa'i sku/ /dri med 'od kyis phan bde rgyas mdzad pa'i/ pad+ma dkar po'i zhabs= 'gro ba kun la dam pa'i lam ston cing*/ bdud dang kla klo'i chos sogs mthar byed pa/ sa bcu'i dbang phyug rgyal sras khro bo'i sku| |rigs ldan nyi shu gsum la=

sgrol mas lung bstan sham+bha lar byon nas| |rigs ldan rgyal pos dngos su byin brlabs shing*/ /rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i tshogs la dbang 'byor ba'i/ /grub chen dus 'khor zhabs= /zab lam rdo rje'i rnal 'byor legs bsgoms pas/ /phyag rgya chen po'i dngos grub rab bsnyes te// dus kyi 'khor lo'i bstan pa rgyas mdzad pa'i/ /dus zhabs gnyis pa'i zhabs= phyi nang grub mtha' rgya mtsho'i pha rol son/ khyad par rgyud sde zab mo'i don rtogs te| |gangs can 'gro ba'i dpal du legs byon pa'i/ /paṇa chen zla mgon zhabs= gus pas bla ma'i zhabs pad legs bsten pas/ /gzhung dang gdams pa ma lus yongs rdzogs shing*/ /bsgoms pas yon tan rigs chen gter kha bye| |sgom pa dkon mchog bsrungs= mtha' bral lta ba'i de nyid legs rtogs nas| |bde stong zung 'jug lam la rab gnas shing*/ /thabs mkhas thugs rjes gzhan gyi don mdzad pa'i/ /sgro ston gnam la rtsegs= /bde gsal phyag rgya chen po'i don rtogs nas/ /zung 'jug bde ba chen po rab bsgom pas/ / rnal 'byor dbang phyug chen po'i rtogs pa brnyes/ grub chen yu mo zhabs= /sngon bsags tshogs gnyis rgya chen shugs goms pas/ /zab cing rgya che'i chos rnams ma lus la/ /zab yangs mkhyen pa'i ye shes rab rgyas pa/ /chos kyi dbang phyug zhabs=/ thos pas sde snod zab mo'i don rig cing*/ /bsgoms pas rgyud sde zab mo'i rtogs pa rgyas/ /bshad pas gdul bya zab mo'i lam la sbyor// nam mkha' 'od zer zhabs= dpag yas ting 'dzin sgo mang rab phye nas/ /ngo mtshar mngon shes rnam 'phrul mtha' yas ston/ /bcu drug skye bas byang chub mchog brnyes pa'i/ / grub thob se mo che la= 'chad rtsod rtsom pas bshad brgyud bstan pa spel/ /lta spyod sgom pas bsgrub brgyud bstan pa 'dzin/ /mkhyen rtse'i nus pas gdul bya'i don kun mdzad/ /'jam dbyangs gsar ma'i zhabs= mdo rgyud man ngag kun la legs goms pas/

/mtha' yas lung rtogs chos kyi gter gyur cing*/ /ma byon sangs rgyas gsum par yongs grags pa'i/ /chos sku 'od zer zhabs= sde snod rgyud sde mang po'i don gzigs nas/ /dben pa'i gnas su sgrub pa lhur mdzad pas/ /rtogs pa'i mchog brnyes sgrub brgyud bstan pa spel/ kun spangs chos rje'i zhabs= gsang sngags rgya mtsho'i tshul la rab sbyangs nas/ /rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i lam la rab brtson zhing*/ /yon tan rgya mtsho sbas pa'i rnal 'byor pa/ kun mkhyen 'phags pa 'od= dge tshogs rin chen dpag med las grub cing*/ /mkhyen brtse'i phrin las phun tshogs rab rgyas pas| rtsod dus thams cad mkhyen par rab grags pa'i/ chos rje bu ston zhabs la= dus gsum sangs rgyas ngo bo rdo rje 'chang*/ /srid gsum sems can kun gyi gnyen gcig po/ /sa gsum 'gran dang bral ba chos kyi rgyal/ /chos rje rin po che= sangs rgyas kun dngos bla ma khyed rnams la/ /rtag tu sgo gsum gus pas gsol ba 'debs/ /sku gsung thugs dang ye shes rdo rje yis/ /dus dang rnam pa kun du byin gyis brlobs/ khams drug ldan zhing tshogs gnyis bsags pa'i lus| |kun rtog 'pho ba'i bag chags kun bskrus nas/ /lam zab rin chen rgyan gyis legs spras te/ /mi 'gyur dga' bde rgyas par byin gyis rlobs// srid gsum srid zhi'i mtsho las sgral bya'i phyir/ /dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi lam gcig pu/ /thog mtha' bar gsum dge ba'i rnal 'byor mchog /yid ches gsum ldan bsgoms par= /rnam kun mchog ldan stong pa'i yul rnams la// sgrib bral dbang po'i tshogs rnams rab 'jug cing*/ /ma dag 'khrul pa'i las snang kun nub te/ /bzung 'dzin rang sar grol par= rang gi sems kyi snang ba las byung ba'i/ /nam mkha'i lam gnas stong nyid phyag rgya che/ /gzugs med gzugs 'chang rdul bral dri ma med/ /snang stong dbyer med rtogs par= /rmi lam sgyu ma dri za'i grong khyer dang*/

/pra phab snang ba mig 'phrul gzugs brnyan bzhin| |yod med rtag chad bral bar legs rtogs nas/ /phyogs 'dzin kun dang bral bar= /shes rab rtog dang dpyod dang dga' ba dang*/ /g.yo med bde ba chen po nyid thob ste/ gzugs sems dbyer med gcig tu 'dres gyur nas// dag pa'i mngon shes 'char bar= /srog rlung nyi zla'i rgyu ba dang bral zhing*/ /rtag tu dbu ma'i nang du legs zhugs nas/ /steng 'og 'khor lo'i lte bar rab bkod de/ /rtag tu g.yo med 'dzin par= gtum mo ye shes snang ba rab rgyas pas| |'dod pa'i lha mthong gzugs brnyan rnam rtog bral/ /dri med 'od kyi dkyil 'khor gsal ldan pas/ /lus las khams gsum spro bar= 'od gsal phyag rgya che la rjes chags pas/ /mi 'gyur bde ba dbugs kyi grangs 'phel te// 'khor 'das ro mnyam bden gnyis dbyer med pa'i| zung 'jug bde ba chen por= |bden gnyis dbyer med lam la legs goms pas/ /gnyis su 'dzin pa thams cad rnam spangs te/ /e waṃ thabs shes bde stong la sogs pa/ /dbyer med zung 'jug thob par= /chos kun gzhi rtsa gnas skabs rnam pa bzhi/ /rnal 'byor bzhi sogs lam gyis legs dag ste/ / sku bzhi rdo rje bzhi dang mkhyen pa bzhi| |byang chub bzhi sogs thob bar= /gzhi la gnas pa'i rigs drug dri ma rnams| |zab lam yan lag drug gis legs sbyangs ste/ khams drug sgrib bral 'bras bu mchog thob nas/ /'gro drug sems can 'dren par= ma dag 'khor ba'i sum bcu rtsa drug rigs/ /dag pa'i so drug rigs su gnas gyur te/ /phung khams dbang yul las dbang bya ba gzhan/ /sgrib bral so drug thob par= phung khams skyed byed las dbang bya ba rnams/ /sgrib med ro mnyam gcig tu 'dres gyur te/ /bde chen waṃ yig stong chen 'gyur med lnga/ /ye shes lnga ldan thob par= sum bcu rtsa drug rigs rnams sgrib bral nas/ /rang bzhin 'od gsal bde ba chen po'i gnas/

/chos kun rten gcig e yig thig le stong*/ 'gyur med rnam drug thob par= rlung me chu sa lhun po pad+ma dang*/ /zla nyi sgra gcan mkha' sogs sgrib bral te/ /phyi nang gzhan gsum kun khyab ye shes mchog/rnam bcu dbang ldan thob par= dus sbyor bcu gnyis rlung gi rgyu ba 'gags/ /rten 'brel bcu gnyis phyi nang sgrib pa zad/ /gnas sogs bcu gnyis sa rnams legs bgrod de| |bde don bcu gnyis ldan par= 'gyur ba dga' ba bcu drug mun pa sangs| |stong nyid snying rje bcu drug dkyil 'khor rgyas/ /bcu drug sku'i cha shas yongs rdzogs ste/ /de nyid bcu drug rig par= nyi khri chig stong drug brgya'i grangs kyi ni/ /las rlung 'pho ba'i skad cig gi bcom ste/ /myur du bde ba'i cha shas kun rdzogs nas/ don gnyis phun sum tshogs par byin gyis rlobs// ces pa 'di/ sbyor ba yan lag drug gi rnal 'byor pa chen po dge ba'i bshes gnyen kun dga' bsod nams pas bskul nas/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa thams cad kyis byin gyis brlabs pa shākya'i dge slong*/ skyabs mchog dpal bzang pos drag po'i lo mchu'i zla ba'i dkar phyogs kyi tshes gcig la sbyar ba'o/ / 'di la rten nas sems can thams cad kyis dpal ldan bla ma sku bzhi'i dbang phyug gi go 'phangs myur du thob par gyur cig 'di'i chos rje bla ma'i 'jug tu/ rgyal ba'i thugs rje gcig bsdus a ti shas/ /rgyal bas legs gsung 'dul ba'i nyams len sogs/ /rgyal ba'i bstan pa spel phyir slar byon pa| |rgyal ba skyabs mchog zhabs la= de sras mthu bo rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas dang*| |de sras grub pa'i dbang phyug tshul khrims 'bar/ /dge sbyong mchog gyur sems dpa' chen po'i mtshan/ /nam mkha' 'od zer zhabs la= tshigs bcad 'og ma 'di gnyis mchan du 'dug pa dkyus la bris pa lags// // na mo rat+na gu ru bheḥ dpal sbyor ba yan lag drug pa'i dpal ldan bla ma'i yon tan kun 'byung ba zhes bya ba/

bla ma dang dpal dus kyi 'khor lo la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rnams kun mchog ldan stong pa'i dkyil 'khor rgyas/ /mchog tu mi 'gyur bde ba'i cha shas rdzogs/ /spangs rtogs mdzad pa'i 'od dkar phyogs bcur 'gyed/ /dpal ldan bla ma mchog la gsol ba 'debs/ /sku bzhi'i mnga' bdag dpal ldan rdo rje 'chang*/ /dbang phyug brgyad ldan shākya'i rgyal po bdun/ /sa bcu'i dbang phyug rigs ldan nyi shu lnga/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyi brlobs/ /tshig rkang 'di kun la sbyar/ /rigs ldan rgyal pos byin rlabs dus 'khor zhabs/ /dus 'khor bstan pa rgyas mdzad dus 'khor zhabs/ /gsang can 'gro ba'i dpal gyur zla ba mgon/ /gzhung dang gdams ngag kun 'dzin dkon mchog bsrungs/ /rang gzhan don gnyis phun tshogs gnam la rtsegs/ /rnal 'byor dbang phyug grub chen yu mo'i zhabs/ / sprul pa'i skyes mchog dharme shwo ra dang*/ /thos bsam bsgoms pas rgyud grol nam mkha' 'od/ /dus gsum rnam mkhyen grub thob se mo che/ /mkhas shing grub pa'i skyes mchog 'jam dbyangs gsar/ /lung rtogs chos kyi spyan ldan chos sku 'od// sgrub rgyud bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan kun spangs zhabs/ /gsang sngags rgya mtsho'i mthar son 'phags pa 'od/ khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po bu ston zhabs/ / dus gsum sangs rgyas kun dngos chos kyi rje/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag brgyud byin gyis brlobs/ /zab yangs shes bya'i mkha' la thogs pa med/ / dmigs med thugs rje'i dkyil 'khor rab tu rgyas/ /lhun grub mdzad pa'i 'od zer phyogs bcur spro/ /chos rje rin po che la gsol ba 'debs/ /kun rtog 'khrul pa'i mun pa ma lus sangs/ /'od gsal dag pa'i snang ba rab 'byams rgyas| |shes dang shes bya'i yul kun gcig tu 'dres/ /chos rje= rlung sems dbu ma'i nang du rab tu brtan/ /bdud dang nyon mongs rgyu ba mtha' dag 'gags| |'byung 'jug 'gro 'ong bral ba'i rtogs pa brnyes/

chos rje= 'khor ba'i rtsa ba 'gyur ba'i bag chags dag /nyi khri chig stong drug brgya'i las rlung 'gags| |mchog tu mi 'gyur bde ba'i yon tan rdzogs/ /chos rje= stong nyid snying rje dbyer med lam la sgoms/ /srid dang zhi ba'i rgya mtsho che las rgal/ / don gnyis phun sum tshogs pa'i sa la bzhugs/ /chos rje rin po che la gsol ba 'debs/ /dpal ldan bla ma'i ded dpon gyis gnang ba'i/ /zab lam rin chen mchog 'di sdig grogs dang*/ /chom rkun rtsa lag rnams kyi ma 'phrogs pas/ rang gzhan don gnyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /nam mkha'i mtha' klas gyur pa'i sems can rnams/ /srid zhi'i rgya mtsho che las sgral phyir du/ /stong nyid snying rje dbyer med rnal 'byor che/ /rtag tu brtson pas sgrub par= rnam g.yeng 'du 'dzis dben pa'i gnas mchog tu/ /don med tshe 'di bya ba kun spangs ste// yid ches gsum dang ldan pa'i zab mo'i lam/ /nyin mtshan rtag tu sgom par = lus dang gnyen shes kun la ltos med par/ /bdag dang bdag gir 'dzin pa kun spangs te/ /dkon mchog bla ma'i skor la mi 'bag par/ /rtag tu zab lam sgom par= zhi sogs dman pa'i dngos grub mi 'dod cing*/ /gzugs sogs rtag pa'i bsgom pa kun spangs te/ /rgyal ba sras bcas kun gyi bgrod gcig lam| |'od gsal phyag chen sgom par= 'gyur ba'i bde ba don du mi gnyer bar| |las dang ye shes phyag rgya las grol ba'i/ /phyag rgya chen mo las byung mi gyur bde/ /thob nas rtag tu bsgom par= de nas gsol 'debs snga ma'i/ / rnam kun mchog ldan stong pa'i yul rnams la/ zhes sogs tshigs bcad gcig dang*| shes rab rtog dang sogs tshigs bcad bzhi dang*/ phyogs 'dzin kun dang bral ba'i don rtogs nas/ /bde stong zung du 'jug pa'i lam sgom zhing*/ / thabs mkhas snying rjes 'gro kun smin byas te/ /myur du sku bzhi thob par= rnam pa kun ldan 'ja' tshon lta bu'i lus/

/'gro kun skad du dam pa'i chos ston cing*/ yod med rtag chad rten bral mtha' gnyis spangs/ /mi 'gyur bde ba mchog tu mthar phyin shog /ces pa 'di yang snga ma dang mdzad pa po dang dus tshes gcig pa nyid do/ /dge'o// // gzhan yang kho bos snga mo nas sbyar ba'i kun la grags pa ni/ na mo mañdzu shri ye/ dbang phyug brgyad ldan rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang*/ /sa bcu'i dbang phyug chos rgyal sum bcu gnyis/ /'jam dbyangs sprul sogs 'phags yul mkhas pa'i tshogs/ /rgyal ba sras dang bcas la gsol ba 'debs/ /sgra bsgyur chos rab la sogs rwa'i tshogs/ /sang dkar bsgom pa la sogs 'bro yi brgyud| |gyi co rtsa mi la sogs brgyud pa gzhan/ /bod yul mkhas grub rnams la= |brgyud pa kun 'dus bu ston chos kyi rje/ /bla ma dam pa lo chen sems dpa' che/ /chos kyi dpal dang 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i zhabs/ /rtsa brgyud mtshungs med rnams la= /'di bla ma dam pa'i rjes la/ rgyal ba gnyis pa skyabs mchog chos kyi rje/ rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas seng ge'i mtshan can dang*/ /rgyas sras mtshungs med sems dpa' chen po'i zhabs/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis brlobs/ /sangs rgyas dpe me mtsho dang dpal 'dzin zhabs/ /'od byed lha dang chos 'byung nyi ma dpal/ /rin chen 'tsho dang bi bhū ti la sogs/ /

nyer brgyud bar ma'i tshogs la= sku bzhi'i dbang phyug rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang*/ / grub pa'i dbang phyug dpal ldan sha ba ri/ /rnal 'byor dbang phyug paṇa chen bi bhū ti/ zab lam ston mdzad gsum las= nyams rtogs mthar phyin grub chen ko brag pa/ /sgrub tshugs mthar phyin rje btsun gzhon nu dpal/ /gnas lnga mthar son thar lo nyi ma'i zhabs/ /zab lam spel mdzad gsum la= rgyal ba gnyis pa bu ston chos kyi rje/ /rgyal sras thu bo 'jam dbyangs chos kyi dpal/ /rgyal ba sku dngos rin chen bsod nams 'phel/ /zab lam rgyas mdzad gsum la gsol ba 'debs/ /rdo rje thig pa'i lam gyi mchog gyur pa/ /rdo rje bzhi yi rnal 'byor mthar phyin pa'i/ /rdo rje 'chang dngos 'jam dbyangs chos kyi rje/ /zab lam gsal mdzad zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /bka' drin mtshungs med rtsa brgyud bla ma la/ / snying nas gus pa'i yid kyis gsol 'debs na/ /gsung rabs mthar thug dus 'khor bshad sgrub kyi/ /bstan pa phyogs mthar rgyas par byin gyis rlobs/ /dbang bdun lam mchog sa bdun spang rtogs sgrub/ /sngags kyi tshogs lam chung ngu rtog sgom lam/ /rdzogs rim smin byed sgo gsum ye shes sbyong*| |bsnyen sgrub bzhi ldan skyed rims mthar phyin shog/bum dbang lam mchog sa brgyad spangs rtogs sgrub/ /tshogs lam 'bring mchog dbang mngon stong gzugs 'dzin/ /gzung 'dzin 'brel gcod dag pa'i mngon shes sgrub| |bsnyen pa'i yan lag sor bsam mthar phyin shog /gsang dbang lam mchog dgu pa'i spang rtogs sgrub/ /sbyor lam thog ma yid mngon rlung sems 'dzin| |nyi zla'i rgyu 'joms g.yo med thig le sgrub/ /nyer sgrub yan lag srog 'dzin mthar phyin shog gsum pa'i lam mchog bcu pa'i spang rtogs sgrub/ / sbyor lam tha ma rang rig 'dod lha 'dzin/ /lte bar 'od kyi stong gzugs phyag chen sgrub/ /sgrub pa'i yan lag rjes dran mthar phyin shog

/bzhi pa'i lam mchog sangs rgyas spang rtogs sgrub/ /'phags pa'i slob lam myur du bde ba che// ye shes sku sgrub bem chos mtha' dag 'joms/ /sgrub chen yan lag ting 'dzin mthar phyin shog/ rnam kun mchog ldan 'ja' lus rdo rje'i sku/ /rang rang skad kyis chos ston gzhom med gsung*/ /stong gzugs kyis 'khyud bde chen mthar thug thugs/ /rdo rje bzhi ldan sku bzhi myur 'grub shog /ces dang*/ bstod chen 'jug gi /mdor na rgyud sde spyi dang khyad par du/ /zhes sogs spro na sbyor/ kun la ma grags pa'i rgyas pa ni/ na mo gu ra we/ drin can rtsa ba yi bla ma/ /bka' drin 'khor med kyi chos rje| |mnyam med 'gro ba yi mgon po/ /dpag yas yon tan gyi mnga' bdag skyabs gnas thams cad kyi gtso bo/ /dge legs thams cad kyi rtsa ba/ / dngos grub thams cad kyi 'byung gnas/ /yon tan thams cad kyi gter mdzod| |sku gsum dbyer med kyi rgyal ba/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas kyi ngo bo/ / theg gsum dam chos kyi 'byung gnas/ /srid gsum sems can gyi 'dren pa/ / dug gsum nad sel gyi sman pa/ /dmus long lam ston gyi sa mkhan/ /ma rig mun sel gyi nyi ma/ /nyon mongs gdung sel gyi zla ba/ /gsol ba snying dkyil nas 'debs so/ /thugs rjes 'bral med du zung shig /byin brlabs char ltar du 'bebs shing*/ /dngos grub bde blag du rtsol shig /bstan pa'i rtsa ba so so thar pa la/ /ma bslabs rtsa ba tul bar gsungs lags kyang*/ /tshig don cung zad shes pa'i nga rgyal gyis/ /'jug ldog yal bar dor ba'i snying khams can/ / bla mas gnang ba'i tshul khrims yid bzhin nor/ /nyes lhung rkun mas khyer ba ma tshor ro/ /tshul khrims gces par 'dzin par byin gyis rlobs/ /rtag tu dran shes bsten par byin gyis rlobs/ /bstan pa'i gzhung shing sgra dang tshad ma la/ / ma bslabs tshig don 'khrul par mthong bzhin du/ /gzhan gyis kha zla med pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis/

/gang shes brjed du 'jug pa'i snying rul po/ /tshig don dag byed shes rab ral gri de/ /rnam g.yeng bzhi mdor bor ba ma tshor ro/ /rtag tu thos bsam nus par= /mi brjed gzungs dang ldan par= /bstan pa'i snying po bden gnyis mngon pa'i chos/ /ma bslabs lta bsgom 'khrul par gsungs lags kyang*/ /gang shes nyams su len 'dod nges 'byung gis/ /ji snyed ji ltar rmongs pa'i snyom las mkhan/ /thabs shes lta spyod yid bzhin nor bu de/ /chog shes rkun mas khyer ba ma tshor ro/ /bden gnyis gnas lugs rtogs= byang chub sems gnyis 'byongs par= /bstan pa'i rtse mo rdo rje theg pa la/ /ma bslabs sangs rgyas thob par mi srid kyang*/ /phyir ltas tshig gi go rgya gcod gcod nas/ /gsang sngags zhor la btong ba'i mtshan nyid pa/ /rdo rje 'chang gi zab lam bdud rtsi'i bcud/ /phyir ltas sa la bo ba ma tshor ro/ /bsnyen sgrub tshad du 'khyol par= /tha mal snang zhen bsgyur bar= /bstan pa'i yang rtse rnal 'byor bla med la/ /ma bslabs thabs shes rdzogs pa mi srid kyang*/ /lag len phyag rgya'i lag khrid byed byed nas/ /rim gnyis yal bar dor ba'i lag len pa/ / sgyu lus 'od gsal bden gnyis nyi zla'i 'od/ /lag len sprin gyis sgribs pa ma tshor ro/ /lus phra sku ru ldang bar= sems phra thugs su 'char bar= bstan pa'i mthar thug dus 'khor rnal 'byor la/ /ma sbyangs zung 'jug rdzogs pa mi srid kyang*/ /gsang dbang gsum pa'i lam gyis chog shes nas/ /dus 'khor logs su 'jog pa'i bla med pa/ /bde chen stong gzugs dpag bsam 'bras bu'i mchog /chog 'dzin ba mos khyer ba ma tshor ro/ /rdo rje'i rnal 'byor sgom par= bzhi pa'i lam 'bras rdzogs par byin gyis rlobs/ /sgo gsum ye shes sbyong bar= stong gzugs mtshan ma rdzogs par= dag pa'i mngon shes 'char bar= nyi zla dbu mar sdom par= 'khor lor= thig le 'dod lhar 'char bar=

mi gyur bde chen rdzogs par= bem chos kun dang bral bar= yan lag bcu gnyis 'gag par= bden don bcu gnyis rdzogs par= de nyid bcu drug rig par= snying rje bcu drug rgyas par= dga' bzhi myur du rdzogs par= gnas skabs bzhi dang bral bar= sku bzhi myur du 'grub par= rdo rje bzhi po myur du mthar phyin shog oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥhaṃ k+ṣaṃḥ oṃ shu n+ya tā dzñā na badz+ra swa bhā wa at+ma ko haṃ/ stong pa nyid du gyur/ rnam kun mchog ldan gyi stong pa'i ngang las/ ka sde dang sa dang po'i rang bzhin nang gi skra dang ba spu nam mkha'i khur yug dang chos kyi dbyings| tsa sde dang sa gnyis pa'i rang bzhin sha dang lpags pa rlung gi 'khor yug dang shar lus 'phags po/ ṭa sde dang sa gsum pa'i rang bzhin khrag dang dmar cha me'i khor yug dang lho 'dzam bu gling*/ pa sde dang sa bzhi pa'i rang bzhin rngul dang dri chu chu'i khor yug dang byang sgra mi snyan/ ta sde dang sa lnga pa'i rang bzhin rkang dang rus pa sa'i khor yug dang nub ba glang spyod/ sa sde dang sa drug pa'i rang bzhin rtsa dang rlung bcu ri'i rgyal po ri rab dang ye shes/ la sde dang sa bdun pa'i rang bzhin dung can ma dang dus me ye shes rdo rje/ a sde dang sa brgyad pa'i rang bzhin dbu ma dang gnyid 'thug sgra gcan rang thugs rdo rje/ l̥ sde dang sa dgu pa'i rang bzhin ra mo dang rmi lam/ nyi ma dang gsung rdo rje/ āḥhaṃ dang sa bcu pa'i rang bzhin rkyang ma dang sad pa zla ba dang sku rdo rje/ gzhan yang rnam bcu dbang ldan/ stong chen yig lnga/ thig le yig drug gi rgyas btab pa'i phyi nang gzhan gsum/ srid zhi 'khor 'das/ lus ngag yid gsum dus gsum dge rtsas bsdus pa'i dpal 'byor thams cad sku bzhi rdo rje'i bzhi'i dbang phyug dam pa dang po'i sangs rgyas khyab bdag dus kyi 'khor lo dang tha mi dad par gyur pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa la dbul bar bgyi'o/ thugs rje 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol/
